review_candidates.title: Mechanical Engineer - Image Quality
review_candidates.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Have you ever wanted to understand what happens between light entering a lens and a high-quality image being produced? Are you interested in how optical design, mechanical precision, manufacturing processes, and environmental conditions shape the performance of advanced imaging systems? FRAMOS is looking for an Image Quality Engineer to join our growing team in Čakovec. Working at the intersection of optics, precision mechanics, and manufacturing, you will help validate, optimize, and improve camera modules used in cutting-edge applications worldwide. This is an excellent opportunity for recent graduates and early-career mechanical engineers who want to build expertise in optics, imaging systems, precision mechanics, advanced manufacturing, and embedded technologies. WHAT WILL YOU WORK ON? You don't need prior experience in optics or imaging – you will learn with us. You will start with clear tasks such as: Running tests that help us understand the mechanical and optical behavior of camera modules during product onboarding and validation. Evaluating how optical alignment, mechanical assembly, and tolerances affect image quality performance. Learning to operate and configure specialized laboratory and measurement equipment such as optical benches, calibration devices, and environmental test systems. Investigating the effects of manufacturing variation, mechanical tolerances, vibration, temperature changes, and other environmental conditions on product performance. Supporting process automation and continuous improvement initiatives that help us manufacture camera modules with the highest quality standards. Performing root cause analysis and solving engineering problems using measurement data, statistical methods, Python, SQL, and other engineering tools. Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to improve product robustness, manufacturability, and production yields. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR? We're looking for someone who is: Curious about how complex products are designed, built, tested, and improved. Interested in optics, imaging systems, precision engineering, manufacturing processes, product validation, and quality improvement. Comfortable working with measurements, technical analysis, and engineering problem-solving. Open to learning new technologies, tools, and methods. Motivated, reliable, and proactive. Enjoy collaborating with engineers from different technical disciplines. Able to work on-site in Čakovec. Comfortable communicating in English on a daily basis. A degree in Mechanical Engineering is especially relevant for this role. review_candidates.description: Head – Quality Assurance (QA) | Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Location: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) Employment Type: Full-time | Expatriate Experience: 8–12 years Industry: Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Head – Quality Assurance (QA) to lead the QA function at a pharmaceutical manufacturing plant in Kinshasa. The role will be responsible for GMP/cGMP compliance, quality systems, IPQA, documentation, deviations, CAPA, change control, validation, and audit readiness. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the QA function and QA team. Ensure compliance with WHO GMP/cGMP requirements. Manage SOPs, BMRs, BPRs, specifications, and document control. Oversee IPQA activities across manufacturing and filling operations. Review batch manufacturing and packing records. Manage deviations, CAPA, change controls, non-conformances, and complaints. Conduct root-cause analysis and ensure timely closure of quality actions. Support equipment/utility qualification, process validation, and cleaning validation. Coordinate internal audits, self-inspections, and external regulatory/customer audits. Ensure audit readiness and proper documentation. Coordinate GMP and SOP training for Production, QA, Warehouse, and other teams. Mentor and develop QA team members. Candidate Requirements Graduate/Postgraduate in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Microbiology, or Life Sciences. 8–12 years of QA experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing. Minimum 3 years in a QA supervisory/managerial role. Strong experience in GMP/cGMP, QMS, IPQA, BMR/BPR review, Deviation, CAPA, and Change Control. Experience in sterile/parenteral manufacturing, IV fluids, LVP/SVP is highly preferred. Experience with regulatory/customer audits. Knowledge of IQ/OQ/PQ, process validation, and cleaning validation. Strong documentation and root-cause analysis skills. Experience with electronic QMS is an advantage. English required; French proficiency preferred. Willingness to relocate and work full-time in Kinshasa, DRC. To Apply please share your updated CV to recruitment@themigration.company
